title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake - Sweah Castle (Brick Breaking Room)
description:
Another background of Sweah Castle, from Ganbare Goemon 4. This particular room has tons of concrete bricks and a evil hand that tries to break them. The player must be careful for it to not break a platform they're standing on. It can fit temples or dojo-like levels.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
